projection_schema.candidate_id: Unique string: finding_id for findings ('finding:...'), hypothesis_id for hypotheses ('h-...')
projection_schema.content: Claim or hypothesis natural language assertion
projection_schema.source_revision: Working state revision of candidate origin
projection_schema.candidate_hash: SHA-256 of canonical JSON (target_type, target_id, claim_type, text, evidence_refs)

staleness_guarantee: Candidate hash mismatch or source revision mismatch triggers HTTP 409 Conflict.
